verdicts.reason: A: the headline is crammed against the left and top edges with almost no margin and fills the banner's full height. The logo floats in the middle-right with its wordmark looking clipped ('SOLSTICL'), and the product can is shrunk to a tiny icon inside a decorative circle, so the brand and product barely register. B: it leaves a large dead area on the left and shrinks the subhead to small, low-contrast text. The logo is a tiny mark sitting on a decorative circle in the corner, and the can is small, but margins and vertical rhythm are more controlled, so B is the less broken of the two.
